claude.rationale: The deal is a passive minority preferred-equity contribution: Inland American "placed into the venture ... CAPITAL ... no operating product line, producing facility, or workforce was contributed," and the venture is an existing entity controlled and managed by Lex-Win as managing member. No T4 product and no T5 process crossed the boundary from Inland American, so there is no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0); likewise neither process nor workforce/organization transferred, so there is no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0). Because nothing operational moved and Inland American gains only equity-method access to the ongoing debt-investing business, T4/T5/T6 are null and T2 is read-only.
